body.statement: Every feasible finite rational linear program with finite optimum has primal and dual optimal solutions with equal objective values. If a rational, well-described dual polyhedron has a polynomial-size bounding ball and a polynomial-time strong separation oracle, the ellipsoid optimization--separation method computes both an optimal dual solution and a primal certificate in time polynomial in the encoding length and the oracle complexity.

source.locator: Groetschel--Lovasz--Schrijver, Geometric Algorithms and Combinatorial Optimization, Chapter 6, optimization--separation equivalence for well-described polyhedra

attestation.note: Stable DOI supplied for the standard rational linear-programming duality and strong optimization--strong separation result.
